Text: Shuttle Excursion

You take a shuttle out with {d(Child)} for a few days. You explore {StarSystem} with {him(Child)}, showing {him(Child)} the planets and moons.

Suddenly, there's a loud bang; the craft starts to list, and you cannot regain control!
What do we do now?

Glancing at the instruments, you see the shuttle is rapidly losing power. You only have a short window before the whole craft goes dead. You are in a little-travelled part of the system; it could be days before anyone comes across you.
